The Birthday Letter

For my birthday she wrote a letter dipped in coffee and burnt the edges so it looked vintage, because she knows I'm a vintage person. 😭

She put the letter inside a shmol black bag with her favourite scent sprayed on it, along with lots of flowers she picked for me.

i still have it exactly as she gave it. coffee stains, burnt edges, the scent almost gone now — but not the way it made me feel.

The Soundtrack of Us

Every song means something.

Champagne Coast

Reminds me of our first lil one-month anniversary, when we were still figuring things out — spending time with her, building the connection.

Open Arms

She introduced this song to me. It became the one I liked most in our Spotify Jam. We'd sit in the garden listening to it while staring at each other. 😭

Every Breath You Take

This was when we finally figured everything out. Whenever I woke up on the Indhira Canteen road, I used to listen to this thinking about her. This was when we properly became partners.

Hey Ya

The peak of our relationship. Constant messages, constant meetings, everything constant and uphill. This one specifically reminds me of January 10th, seeing the night sky and buildings from the top of the apartment.

Anchor

Another one she shared with me. This song understimulates me. The last song that reminded me of her before June 11th. 🥺

this close, always
